record: T10 evidence-based desktop startup and long-task performance

conditions.nodeNote: mise.toml pins node 24.14.0 but mise is not installed on this machine; all numbers here were produced with the system Node v26.3.0 and are NOT directly comparable to the earlier record made with Node 24.14.0
conditions.scrollFixture: packages/web/perf-studio-timeline.html with 10,000 synthetic messages, viewport 1440x900, in-browser only (not a persisted history)

desktopBuild.note: NOT rebuilt in this task; HEAD is c763651, so the packaged bytes are older than the source tree and no main/renderer source change made here is reflected in these numbers

conditions.desktopData: isolated temp profile via KNORVIA_PORTABLE_DIR (data root <temp>/data); fresh directory for the cold sample, same directory reused for warm samples
conditions.coldWarmSplit: 1 cold + 2 warm comparable samples per run; the ready-to-send sample is a separate later launch because it writes the onboarding record

scrollDispersion.note: rafCallbacksPerSecond is headless requestAnimationFrame throughput, not physical display FPS

runHistory.fixture: real StudioRunHistory component imported by the perf script into the existing Vite/Chrome perf page; 100 synthetic runs x 8 steps, non-compact panel (= group details / workflow history pane)

samples.updateMsNote: metric was invalid in this run (waited for any mutation), not used

samples.recordedFrom: same script, window temporarily widened to 1000 runs (equivalent to pre-change rendering)

after.codeState: bounded window of 20 runs plus an explicit "Show older runs" control

measuredEffect.historyReachability: after clicking "Show older runs" until it disappears, 101/101 runs and 808/808 step rows are mounted (nothing lost)

desktop.coldVsWarm: no difference beyond run-to-run dispersion (+/- ~5%); the dominant cost repeats on every launch, so it is not first-run schema creation

finalSamplePhasesFromProcessCreateMs.launcherAttachNote: time until Playwright returned the Electron main process handle; overlaps with main-module evaluation and is measurement overhead, not user-visible startup

finalSampleHostStartupFromProcessCreateM.source: the application's own production log (<profile>/data/.knorvia-studio/v2/logs/<date>.log); host lines are relayed to the main process, so timestamps are receive times (~ms relay offset)

readyToSend.note: the isolated profile completes onboarding (3 skips) and dismisses the first-run guide before the composer is measured, so this number includes scripted interaction time and is not a pure launch phase

logCheck.sensitiveContent: none observed: workspace paths under the isolated temp profile, provider registry revision hashes, channel registration and RPC timing only
logCheck.finding: packages/rpc/src/logging-middleware.ts logs every RPC call and every event subscription at info; only agent.backgroundBashOutputV4 OK is demoted to debug in packages/desktop/src/host/rpcLogLevel.ts. Not a raw stream dump, but a per-call growth vector in long sessions. Out of this task's write scope; reported, not changed.

notInvestigated: kernel/CLI probe cost: no local CLI kernel was detected on this machine (host log: "Knorvia agent binary path: <not found>", providerCount 0), and kernel probing is renderer-driven after first paint; the ~20 s ACP handshake noted in packages/services/src/studio-runtime/adapters/kernels/README.md could not be reproduced here
the dominant host-side cost (storage preparation: 2.84-3.05 s per launch) is owned by packages/desktop/src/host/* and packages/services storage sessions, outside this task's write scope
real model / CLI / SSH send latency, real persisted 10,000-message history memory, installer wizard, human visual review, physical display frame rate
